divergence_justification: Inherited divergence with no creatinine_baseline-originated loss. All divergence   rows (460 age, 460 mdrd_est, 85 scr_baseline) trace to the age dependency, already   accepted as COMPLETED_WITH_DIVERGENCE by human decision. Root cause is upstream:   mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_patient.sql:15 synthesises Patient.birthDate as   MIN(transfers.intime)-anchor_age instead of anchoring to anchor_year, so FHIR-side   age diverges from canonical age.sql:30 exactly where year(MIN(transfers.intime)) !=   anchor_year. Independently verified on full MIMIC-IV v2.2 (HPC job 29971523): 460/431,231   admissions across 87 patients, error range -3..+13 years; anchor_year is recoverable   from no published timestamp (six candidate identities swept, best 99.9710%, none exact).   The age>=18 cohort filter flips 0 rows in practice. Upstream defect with a one-line fix,   reported as mimic-fhir/debug-patient-birthdate-anchor; the identical port becomes exact   once it lands. 430,771/431,231 (99.8933%) identical, no row gaps.
